title: Cache-aside helper: past-TTL read miss triggers a second origin call
asA: developer relying on cache-aside for staleness bounds
iWant: the cache-aside helper to re-invoke origin after the elicited TTL elapses
soThat: the applied project observes a bounded staleness ceiling that matches the elicited TTL

acceptanceCriteria.description: After the TTL elapses (in-memory driver clock advances past the expiration), cache-aside.getOr(key, originFn) finds nothing and invokes originFn a second time. The invocation counter reaches 2 and the returned value comes from origin.
acceptanceCriteria.when: getOr(key, originFn) runs after clock advance past TTL
acceptanceCriteria.then: the invocation counter reaches 2; the returned value comes from origin

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-6 per-call TTL override: cacheAside.getOr(key, originFn, {ttl:120}) writes back with the per-call TTL (120 seconds) even when the elicited default is 60. A subsequent read at 90 seconds elapsed returns cache (source cache); a read at 121 seconds returns origin (source origin). The elicited default is a fallback, never a ceiling.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a cache-aside helper with elicited default TTL 60 and a fake clock
acceptanceCriteria.when: getOr(key, originFn, {ttl:120}) writes and reads land at 90s and 121s elapsed
acceptanceCriteria.then: the 90s read is cache; the 121s read is origin; the kvWrite record carries ttl:120

acceptanceCriteria.description: Per-call TTL below floor clamps: cacheAside.getOr(key, originFn, {ttl:0.5}) is subject to the 1-second floor per ADR-3202 (AC-31105-2). The effective TTL clamps to 1; behaviour then matches the TTL-floor AC.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a cache-aside helper with a fake clock and a per-call TTL of 0.5 seconds
acceptanceCriteria.when: getOr runs and reads land at 500ms and 1001ms elapsed
acceptanceCriteria.then: the 500ms read is cache; the 1001ms read is origin (behaviour identical to a per-call TTL of 1)

acceptanceCriteria.description: TTL boundary is strict less-than: with per-call TTL of 5 seconds, a read at EXACTLY 5000ms elapsed returns origin (source origin), not cache. The boundary treats the TTL as an inclusive expiry: at t=ttl the entry is expired.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a cache-aside helper with a fake clock and per-call TTL 5
acceptanceCriteria.when: a read lands at exactly 5000ms elapsed
acceptanceCriteria.then: the read is origin (source origin); the entry has expired at the boundary
